auditoria.erro: mcp: Sonnet changed 'unknown' to 'no' without README support and without listing it in o_que_mudou while declaring 'confirma'; catalog convention keeps 'unknown'. Card names also include unrelated aliases (MCP Markdown Content Protocol, Fuse.js-Text-Parser).

final.role: Markdown parser (CommonMark, extensible) usable to parse notes before indexing
final.evidence: Markdown parser done right. Fast and easy to extend. Follows the CommonMark spec; npm install markdown-it.

auditoria.nota: Parser Markdown em JS; útil para fatiar notas por cabeçalho antes de indexar, não é camada de busca.
